subject: We blocked a sign-in attempt to your account
summary: Northwind blocked a sign-in attempt to Alex's online banking from a new device in Lagos, Nigeria at 3:12am PT.
reason: A genuine-looking security alert about their own account from a matching bank domain; they should confirm whether it was them and change password if not.
action: Confirm it wasn't you; change password via the Northwind app if so
body_text: We blocked a sign-in to your Northwind online banking from a new device in Lagos, Nigeria at 3:12am PT. If this wasn't you, sign in from the Northwind app (not from this email) and change your password.
